authority.OBDATA091: Explicit candidate evidence requirement and evidence-category authority.
authority.OBDATA092: Category-level observation coverage and independent-family coverage.
authority.OBDATA093: Independent-support requirements prevent raw observation count from masquerading as sufficient support.
authority.OBDATA094: Candidate-level sufficiency with required-category, unresolved-gap and fail-closed integrity handling.

doctrine: admitted evidence is not automatically sufficient evidence
independent evidence is not automatically sufficient evidence
raw evidence count is not candidate sufficiency
required evidence categories must be explicitly satisfied
required independent support must be explicitly satisfied
unknown dependency receives no independent-support credit
blocked independence integrity blocks candidate sufficiency
known_boundary: OBDATA091-095 evaluates evidence sufficiency only; it does not determine an analytical conclusion.

Evidence category assignments and requirement policy are explicit inputs. Future integration must bind them to canonical observation types and mode/policy authority rather than arbitrary caller-supplied strings.
The independence_integrity_state input is currently an explicit normalized state. Future integration should consume the actual OBDATA086-090 assessment receipt.
SUFFICIENT means structurally sufficient for analytical reasoning only. It is not a trade recommendation, contract selection, or execution permission.
title: Candidate Evidence Sufficiency Authority
